results: Full `npm test` chain (syntax checks + 45 suites incl. test/context.js) observed EXIT 0 with zero ✗/FAILED/ABORT lines on commit d0f7787's tree (e.g. smoke 760, security 158, activation 478, ucos-mm 326, context 83); log not committed, sha256 f8e37eb28c3fa0fad5101f3a8d024bb5665bd8d4f62485a2b606133b2f90de8e.
Five source-of-truth conflicts found by reproduction and recorded as CNF-001..CNF-005; none resolved (owner decisions).

Two defects in the new engine were found by its own tests and fixed before commit: requires inside string literals were read as dependencies (fixed with a lexical mask), and stableJSON emitted `undefined` (invalid JSON).
limitations: Pack summaries are extracted, not semantic (G-2); code↔spec implements edges mostly absent (G-3); schema.sql drift unchecked (G-4); only verbatim duplication detected (G-5).
Scale limits measured only at the current size (318 files, ~1.7 s check).
risks: Every commit that changes a registered file must also commit the regenerated _context/ — CI fails otherwise (intended, but new to contributors).
CNF-002 (seal hashes a non-existent input) means edits to UCRS-Zero-Hardcoding-Constitution.md do not drift the seal until the G1 fix lands.
